title: Run history
readOnly: Saved local records. Viewing history does not start an agent. Archived questions and permissions are read-only and cannot be answered here.
empty: No saved runs in this scope. Try all saved runs or a stable engine and session ID.
noEvents: No recorded events for this run.
interruptedHelp: This run was interrupted before an end record was saved. Review its saved work before resuming the engine session; it is not marked complete.
